purpose: Technical proposals for independent scientific selection;not ranked GO decisions

candidates.name: Uncertainty-aware fixed eigenphase macrocycle
candidates.construction: V(h)=product of symmetric S_j(a_l*h), palindrome,a_l>=0,sum a_l=1;D_theta=sum a_l^3 D_j.
required_information: Same original H kernel dictionary,excluding conjugation/cyclic isospectral duplicates
Certified eta_j or explicit empirical status
candidates.selector: Joint native quantum/preparation cost plus information acquisition,using |sum a^3 tilde d|+sum a^3 eta;no exact ground state/energy/gap.
candidates.reduction_mechanism: Smaller relevant energy perturbation permits a larger step if the certificate and overlap costs do not erase savings.
candidates.possible_delta: Cheap information-bound generation and spectrally distinct dictionary with matched native cost and branch semantics;unproved.
blocking_conditions: Pure processor or uniform subdivision only
candidates.minimum_future_validation: Off-domain noncommuting three-fragment family,negative state-quality control,uniform subdivision/S4/known ordering comparators;separate fixed numerical scope needed.

candidates.name: Branch-checked finite PF eigenvalue extrapolation
candidates.construction: E_ext=(4 E(h/2)-E(h))/3 for the same ground-connected branch;under uniform |R(s)|<=C*s^4 bias<=5C*h^4/12.
required_information: Same branch at both fixed kernels
Certified finite-h remainder or empirical designation
Ground overlap/preparation costs and per-method phase-estimation cost
candidates.selector: Fixed nodes and error allocation;under cost A_i/epsilon_i,matched output width has cost (sum sqrt(A_i|w_i|))^2/epsilon_stat.
candidates.reduction_mechanism: Trade extra phase estimates/statistical precision for reduced PF discretization bias.
candidates.possible_delta: An operational cheap branch/remainder verification and native cost allocation;extrapolation itself is known.
candidates.minimum_future_validation: One saved H/kernel and two pre-fixed steps with wrong-branch control,S4 and existing Chebyshev comparator;no current data evaluation.

candidates.name: Coefficient-window Schur self-energy ground root
candidates.construction: H=[[A,B],[Bdag,D]],K(E)=A-B(D-E)^-1 Bdag;root of lambda_min(K(E))-E in [L,U] with U<c<=lambda_min(D).
required_information: Explicit A/B/D controlled implementation and preparation access
candidates.selector: Use uniform resolvent series remainder and interval signs of f(E);never select with full-H E0 or true gap.
candidates.reduction_mechanism: Eliminate explicit external-mode degrees while retaining their virtual energy contribution,if a short self-energy circuit is cheaper.
candidates.possible_delta: Efficient controlled self-energy generation with original-H error interval from coefficient-accessible quantities;not yet established.
blocking_conditions: General chemistry outside current proof class
candidates.minimum_future_validation: New separately approved one-external rational fixture,bare active and known downfolding controls;static body-rank/resource gate before performance.

candidates.name: Sequence-cost finite-state RTE proposal
candidates.construction: For fixed F=sum a_gamma U_gamma sample actual q_gamma and weight a_gamma/q_gamma;minimize second-moment-times-cost surrogate,q*=|a|/sqrt(g).
required_information: Fixed finite mean and phase-preserving controllable operators
Actual dyadic/rational proposal,moment,range and tail certificates
candidates.selector: Positive quadrature of inverse-sqrt cost plus backward DP;whole-path defensive mixture keeps support. Existing digital law is not overwritten.
candidates.reduction_mechanism: Reduce expected weighted native whole-path cost including basis/cancellation and preparation,subject to finite-confidence accounting.
candidates.possible_delta: Provably small cost-state representation and inexpensive law/moment/range certification for a useful sequence class;not importance sampling principle.
blocking_conditions: True full normalizer or cheap compile oracle required
candidates.minimum_future_validation: Off-domain bounded-state paths against original and termwise law,oracle only diagnostic,state-growth counterexample;no D1 new IR or sampling.
